headline: 30 Claude Agents for the Whole LinkedIn Inbound Team
subhead: Thirty agents, one job each: rewrite your profile, sharpen a draft, answer a comment, name your lead magnet, and reply to the DM when someone finally raises a hand.
subhead_secondary: Each one is a single instruction file you paste into a Claude chat, with a practice draft included so you can watch it run before you use your own.
inside: Profile headline, About opener, and Featured section picks
Post hooks, structure cuts, and detail checks
Comment angles and reply threads under your posts
Lead magnet naming, cover lines, and gate keywords
Inbound DM replies and the call ask
proof: I run this exact engine on my own feed. The profile rewrites, comment angles, and DM replies in this pack are pieces of it, cut small enough for one person to run in a chat.
open_micro: No email needed. Yours to keep.
optin_head: Want them in your inbox too?
optin_micro: One email with the link. Nothing else.
optin_done: Sent. Check your inbox in a minute.
